title: Public Templates pages: gallery, one page per published template, sitemap and robots, old Design inspiration addresses redirect
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/public-templates-page.test.mjs
S2: Read the lines for the tests named in run.tests.
expect: S2: every named test reports ok: a template page carries its name, CMS, demo and canonical link; an unknown id answers 404; the gallery lists every published template; /design-inspiration and the old platform addresses move permanently to /templates/; the sitemap lists the gallery and every template page; off production every page says noindex; cookie tracy_lang=vi gives Vietnamese words.

selectors.doors: GET /templates/, GET /templates/<id>/, GET /design-inspiration, GET /sitemap.xml, GET /robots.txt, GET /llms.txt

fence: apps/tracy-web/src/public/templates-page.js and design-inspiration-redirects.js: pages read the published list on each request, redirects keep utm keys, indexing only on production.

tests: a template page carries its name, blurb, CMS, every layout, the demo and a canonical link
an unknown or unpublished id answers 404 with a way back to all templates
the gallery lists every published template, with a filter button and count per existing platform
a platform name is never read as a template id, and its old address moves to the gallery
/design-inspiration, with or without the slash, moves permanently to /templates/
the sitemap lists the gallery and every template page, and no platform address
off production every Templates page and the sitemap say noindex in header and meta
cookie tracy_lang=vi gives Vietnamese words on the gallery and the detail page, no cookie gives English
